dialogues.jp: 「ちっ、ここもダメか……」
dialogues.en:
"It's such a nice day. I think I'll have some bread outside
in the garden."
dialogues.text:
"It's such a nice day. I think I'll have some bread outside
in the garden."

dialogues.jp:
中庭で、のんびりパンを食べようと思ったら、
来るのが遅かったのか、ベンチは全部埋まって
いた。
dialogues.en:
Suginami and Mako were gone, and Nemu was still writing
something in her notebook.
dialogues.text:
Suginami and Mako were gone, and Nemu was still writing
something in her notebook.

dialogues.jp:
仕方がないので、他に静かなところとして、体
育館裏辺りをチョイスしてみたのだが、
dialogues.en: "Is she copying what's on the blackboard?"
dialogues.text: "Is she copying what's on the blackboard?"

dialogues.jp: 「こんなところで、色めき立つなっての」
dialogues.en: She's such a perfectionist, but very slow.
dialogues.text: She's such a perfectionist, but very slow.

dialogues.jp:
なにやら、体育館裏では甘ったるい告白劇が行
われていた。
dialogues.en: "Well, if I need something, I can look at her notes."
dialogues.text: "Well, if I need something, I can look at her notes."

dialogues.jp:
さすがに、『気にしなくてイイヨ』なんて言い
ながら、横で飯は食えまい。
dialogues.en: I walked out of the classroom in order to get some lunch.
dialogues.text: I walked out of the classroom in order to get some lunch.

dialogues.jp: 「他のところへ行こう……」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
お邪魔虫は、場合によっては、ゴキブリより嫌
われる虫だ。
dialogues.en: I saw a teacher coming up the stairs.
dialogues.text: I saw a teacher coming up the stairs.

dialogues.jp:
中庭まで来ると、やたらと目を血走らせた生活
指導の講師が、校舎の中に入っていった。
dialogues.en:
His eyes were red, and his hair was dyed with a yellow and
clear color......
dialogues.text:
His eyes were red, and his hair was dyed with a yellow and
clear color......

dialogues.jp: 「あん？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
目を血走らせ、髪を黄色と半透明色に染めあげ
て――、ものすごい剣幕だ。
dialogues.en: He passed beside me with an egg shell on his head.
dialogues.text: He passed beside me with an egg shell on his head.

dialogues.jp: 「ありゃりゃ」

よく見ると、なぜか、頭には卵の殻をかぶって
いた。
dialogues.en: "Is he trying to look like that character from that anime?"
dialogues.text: "Is he trying to look like that character from that anime?"

dialogues.en:
I don't know why he had an egg shell on his head, but I
didn't want to know any further details.
dialogues.text:
I don't know why he had an egg shell on his head, but I
didn't want to know any further details.

dialogues.jp: 「昔のアニメキャラみたいだな」
dialogues.en: "Well, I need to get something to eat......"
dialogues.text: "Well, I need to get something to eat......"

dialogues.jp:
頭に卵をのせているというシチュエーションが
よく分からんが、わざわざ生活指導の講師とお
近づきになる必要もあるまい。
dialogues.en:
I bought some buns at the store and went outside to relax in
the garden.
dialogues.text:
I bought some buns at the store and went outside to relax in
the garden.

dialogues.jp:
ふと、ここに帰ってくると、いつの間にかベン
チがいくつか空いていた。
dialogues.en:
It's such a nice day, and I can see other students out
there.
dialogues.text:
It's such a nice day, and I can see other students out
there.

dialogues.jp: これは、ちょうどいい。
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 「さって、飯だ飯……」
dialogues.en: At that moment, I saw Moe-sempai looking around.
dialogues.text: At that moment, I saw Moe-sempai looking around.

dialogues.jp: 「んっ？」
dialogues.en: "Sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「何してるんですか？　その……ティッシュの
　箱なんか持って」
dialogues.en:
"What are you doing? Why do you have a box of tissue paper
in your hand......?"
dialogues.text:
"What are you doing? Why do you have a box of tissue paper
in your hand......?"

dialogues.jp:
反応というか、ツッコミも難しい姿にストレー
トに｛たず／訊｝ねるしかない。
dialogues.en: I just had to ask her.
dialogues.text: I just had to ask her.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それが、手を滑らせて卵を落としてしまった
　んです」
dialogues.en: "Well, my hand slipped, and I dropped an egg."
dialogues.text: "Well, my hand slipped, and I dropped an egg."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "An egg?"
dialogues.text: "An egg?"

dialogues.jp: 辺りの地面を見るが、卵なんて割れてない。
dialogues.en: I looked around on the ground, but I couldn't find the egg.
dialogues.text: I looked around on the ground, but I couldn't find the egg.

dialogues.jp: 「ないですけど……もう拭き取ったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "I don't see any...... Did you wipe it away already?"
dialogues.text: "I don't see any...... Did you wipe it away already?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、掃除をしに下りて来たんですけど……
　見つからなくて」
dialogues.en:
"No. I came down here to clean it up, but I can't find
it......"
dialogues.text:
"No. I came down here to clean it up, but I can't find
it......"

dialogues.jp: 下りてきた？
dialogues.en: She came down here?
dialogues.text: She came down here?

dialogues.jp: 「あのぉ、先輩」
dialogues.en: "Umm, Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Umm, Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「卵を落としたって……どこから？」
dialogues.en: "Where did you drop the egg from......?"
dialogues.text: "Where did you drop the egg from......?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……屋上からですけど……」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... From the rooftop......"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... From the rooftop......"

dialogues.jp:
どう手を滑らせたら、屋上から卵が落ちるのだ
ろうか？
dialogues.en: How can you accidentally drop an egg from the rooftop?
dialogues.text: How can you accidentally drop an egg from the rooftop?

dialogues.jp: （じゃあ、さっきの講師は……）
dialogues.en: (So that teacher I just saw was......)
dialogues.text: (So that teacher I just saw was......)

dialogues.jp: 「先輩、今日のお昼は食堂で食べましょう」
dialogues.en:
"Moe-sempai, I think you ought to eat your lunch in the
cafeteria today."
dialogues.text:
"Moe-sempai, I think you ought to eat your lunch in the
cafeteria today."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「え？　どうしてですか？」
dialogues.en: "What? Why's that?"
dialogues.text: "What? Why's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「なんとなく、先輩と食堂で食べたいな――と
　思ったので」
dialogues.en: "I just want to eat in the cafeteria with you......"
dialogues.text: "I just want to eat in the cafeteria with you......"

dialogues.jp: 今、屋上に戻るのは危険すぎる。
dialogues.en: It's too risky to return to the rooftop right now.
dialogues.text: It's too risky to return to the rooftop right now.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「分かりました。じゃあ、眞子ちゃんも呼んで
　３人で食べましょう」
dialogues.en:
"Okay. Let's ask Mako, and let's eat in the cafeteria
today."
dialogues.text:
"Okay. Let's ask Mako, and let's eat in the cafeteria
today."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうですね……あいつも巻き込まれたら大変
　だろうし。間に合えばいいけど」
dialogues.en: "That's good...... I hope we'll find her in time."
dialogues.text: "That's good...... I hope we'll find her in time."

dialogues.jp: 後半は小声のため息で。
dialogues.en: I spoke with a small voice and gave a sigh.
dialogues.text: I spoke with a small voice and gave a sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あっ、その前に卵を掃除しておかないと」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I need to clean up the egg mess first."
dialogues.text: "Oh, I need to clean up the egg mess first."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「それなら大丈夫ですよ。講師の方が片づけて
　くれましたから」
dialogues.en:
"You don't need to worry about that. A teacher took care of
it already."
dialogues.text:
"You don't need to worry about that. A teacher took care of
it already."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「そうだったんですか。あとでお礼を言わなけ
　ればなりませんね」
dialogues.en: "Oh really? I need to thank him later then......"
dialogues.text: "Oh really? I need to thank him later then......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……俺が言っておきますよ」
dialogues.en: "......I'll thank him later."
dialogues.text: "......I'll thank him later."

dialogues.jp:
今頃、屋上を駆けているであろう講師に思いを
馳せる。
dialogues.en: He must be running around the rooftop by now.
dialogues.text: He must be running around the rooftop by now.

dialogues.jp: ――ありがとう。
dialogues.en: ......Thank you, teacher.
dialogues.text: ......Thank you, teacher.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ行きましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go now?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go now?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 元気に頷く先輩とともに、食堂へと向かう。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai nodded, and we started heading toward the
cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai nodded, and we started heading toward the
cafeteria.

dialogues.jp:
そして、屋上からは、耳障りな叫び声が微かに
響いていた。
dialogues.en: I heard an annoyed scream coming from the rooftop.
dialogues.text: I heard an annoyed scream coming from the rooftop.

dialogues.jp: ◆生まれたての講師◆
dialogues.en: ◆Teacher with an egg shell◆
dialogues.text: ◆Teacher with an egg shell◆

dialogues.jp:
階段で卵の殻をかぶった生活指導の講師とすれ
違う。何かと思いきや、萌先輩が屋上から卵を
落としてしまったものだった。
dialogues.en:
A teacher passed me by on the stairs, with an egg shell on
his head. I later found out that Moe-sempai dropped an egg
from the rooftop.
dialogues.text:
A teacher passed me by on the stairs, with an egg shell on
his head. I later found out that Moe-sempai dropped an egg
from the rooftop.

dialogues.jp:
中庭で落とした卵を探す先輩を連れ、食堂へ向
かう。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai was looking for the egg she dropped in the
garden, but I dragged her to the cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai was looking for the egg she dropped in the
garden, but I dragged her to the cafeteria.

dialogues.jp:
屋上からは、耳障りな叫び声が微かに響いてい
た。
dialogues.en: I heard an annoyed scream coming from the rooftop.
dialogues.text: I heard an annoyed scream coming from the rooftop.
